13618.name: Tormentor's gas bomb
13618.description: This bomb has caused scientists to question the undeniable usefulness of progress. After destroying all life with a gruesome explosion, it covers the affected area with a cloud of mustard gas. Not even grass could grow on that area for years.

1483.name: Landing Old Reich
1483.description: The Old Reich commanding officers underestimated the technology of landing troops to the very heart of the battle, until they lost multiple sector to the enemy drop capsules. Now, landings are used even in the most trivial combat missions

1633.name: "Wolf Pack" landing troop
1633.description: It is not known for certain who was the first person to came up with the idea of using Lycanthropes as landing-troopers, but the result surpassed any expectations. Escaped from the smoking shell of the landing capsule, wild animals do not know pity and mercy, tearing to pieces any who will be on their way.

1914.name: “Wolf pack”
1914.description: Fighters turned into Lycanthropes by carrying out genetic mutations continue to retain the characteristics of the animal behavior of wolves. They also continue to form packs, which makes them even more formidable battle opponents.

1915.name: “Double rage”
1915.description: Sometimes berserkers consumed by battle rage create brotherhoods of blood or origins, joining into deadly packs to defeat a common enemy.

2403.name: Gas bomb
2403.description: This bomb has caused scientists to question the undeniable usefulness of progress. After destroying all life with a gruesome explosion, it covers the affected area with a cloud of mustard gas. Not even grass could grow on that area for years.

2404.name: Minefield
2404.description: Rapid deployment of the minefield will stop even the most impetuous and strong infantry of the enemy.

2424.name: Armageddon
2424.description: Armageddon is a class S carpet bombardment. It destroys all living creatures, regardless of who they are fighting for. It is the last effort, when lives of allies mean much less than defeat. When the commander is forced to choose the lesser of evils.

2430.name: Landing Marauders
2430.description: Implants and bio-modifications make the marauders not to fear for their own lives. This is a key aspect when comes the time to load into a semi-broken capsule and landing into the very thick of the battle.

2797.name: Drop of turrets
2797.description: According to "Ardheim Industries" documentation, this turret was made by Dr Rifenthal who was using scrap materials. Can be significantly upgraded.

2842.name: Drop of Modernized Turret
2842.description: Turret which was fabricated and designed by the best engineers of Ardheim Industries. It is the final stage of the Turret development and serves as a model for the mechanics of the Resistance.

2937.description: Spraying the healing catalyst BF-13a in the air helps to accelerate the healing of the wounds of your fighters.

3072.name: Lair
3072.description: One of the experimental developments of G. Salemsky. Creates a stationary passageway to our world. Used by Lycanthropes from the Abyss.

3135.name: Transformation
3135.description: The result of Gastin Salemsky experiments - crazy genius of the occult sciences. Turns everyone within its scope into lycanthropes. Not recommended getting within its scope or contact with infected.

3417.name: Atillery bombardment of Gustav Bombarder
3417.description: Bombarding enemy positions and troops from large-caliber artillery guns "Storm. 152".

3956.name: Wasteland beaters
3956.description: Only heroes or madmen go in the Wasteland by themselves. The Wasteland nomads have understood long time ago that you need to go there at least in group of three or your bones will be devoured by desert hyenas.

3957.name: Wasteland hunters
3957.description: Nomads of the Wasteland are quite dangerous and unpredictable even when there's only one of them. The more of them gather in one place, the bigger the threat they pose. If only one nomad appears, you can be sure that the others are already sneaking up on your back.

4802.name: Shock troop
4802.description: Attempts to force the mutants to fight in big groups were unsuccessful. Their desire to kill each other was above the need to destroy the enemy. The first success that was achieved is to act in a pair in exchange for mutagen for the survival of a partner.

4803.name: Juggernaut
4803.description: The best result of the interaction of the Mutants, training which allowed to rally them into a group capable of causing significant damage and optimal for elimination, in case of disobedience.

4896.name: "Smashing" landing troop
4896.description: To unleash the power of the Suppressors on the enemy means to sign the death sentence for the fortified positions in the rear of the enemy.\n

4897.name: Drop pod of Wasteland
4897.description: Why force Raiders to run back and forth on the battlefield when we can literally drop them on the enemy from the sky?

5239.name: Troop "Triple blow"
5239.description: Several Blades can be tied together after the ritual of soul interlacement. After that they feel emotions of each other, know everything that at least one of them knows and act in battle as a whole.

5240.name: Battle star
5240.description: Using one of the most complex occult rituals, you can recruit a Crimson Blades troop. They appear at the ends of a huge pentagram, which gave them an this name.

8020.description: The Dark Gods can mislead anyone with their whispers. This spell makes the soldier think that allies are real enemies. Troops affected by treacherous witchcraft will attack their own till they die or until the spell fades off. \n\n(Valid for one squad)

8072.name: Absolute transformation
8072.description: Salemsky managed to improve his transformation spell. He found a way to control the newly converted lycanthropes and transmit knowledge about enemies to them. Now, troops affected by this spell not only turn into bloodthirsty monsters, but also turn against their former comrades. \n\n(Valid for one squad)

8117.name: Joker
8117.description: "A mysterious card emitting a slight red radiance, that can be found in places of occult rituals. Just throw it on the battlefield and it'll randomly summon something or someone to help you defeat the enemy, may be Landing Party, maybe Gas Bombs... who knows?" - Mr. Winterstein's field log

8128.name: Rage
8128.description: Gastin Salemsky is a genius. His next development allows to make a real killing machines out of soldiers. They will shoot more accurately, intuitively finding the most vulnerable spots in the enemy’s armor, and will not flinch before anyone. However, there are also side effects - soldiers couldn't tell enemies and allies apart, they become uncontrollable, aggressive and die pretty quickly... well, who cares? \n\n(Valid for one squad)

947.description: If sacred landing appears, it always means trouble. The situation evolves swiftly. Crusaders burst onto the battlefield and destroy everything long before the enemy has a chance to comprehend what happened.
